extracted.intended_audience: researchers, engineers, and organizations considering engagement with DARPA BTO (potential proposers, program participants, challenge competitors, and transition partners)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for research and development efforts aimed at the DARPA Biological Technologies Office: describes technical thrust areas, desired outcomes, and types of opportunities (R&D programs, challenges, transitions) to help teams align proposals and activities with BTO priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harness AI/ML for transformative biological science
rubrics_metrics.description: BTO leverages advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to create new opportunities for transformative science across the biological spectrum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should integrate AI/ML capabilities to enable transformative research outcomes in biology; proposals that explicitly use AI/ML to advance biological understanding or accelerate development are aligned with BTO goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission alignment — protect and enable warfighter health and performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Warfighter health and well-being are critical to mission success; BTO develops diagnostics, assessment systems, medical countermeasures, and approaches to tactical care, performance, and recovery on and off the battlefield.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly articulate how the outcome protects, restores, or optimizes warfighter health, readiness, or recovery, including diagnostics for chemical/biological threats and tactical medical interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create resilient infrastructures, supply chains, and protective solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage biological processes, technologies, and manufacturing to create resilient infrastructures and supply chains, protective solutions, and innovative sensors to ensure mission success in any location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should demonstrate how biology-enabled technologies improve resilience, supply-chain security, distributed manufacturing, or provide new sensing/protection capabilities for operational environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Factories — Generate
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate: Vastly improving the quality and quantity of biological data while reducing costs; increasing speed and automation of cloud labs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should propose methods to scale biological data generation, reduce per-sample cost, and automate experimental workflows (e.g., cloud labs) to accelerate research throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Factories — Understand
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand: Exploring the state of the art and enlisting stakeholders to construct necessary research portfolio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efforts should assess current capabilities, identify gaps, and coordinate stakeholder engagement to build a coherent research portfolio that advances understanding of biological systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Factories — Simulate
rubrics_metrics.description: Simulate: Enabling sequence to function and function to sequence that underpins whole cell modeling and cell–cell interactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should enable predictive simulation linking sequence and function at scales that support whole-cell models and interactions between cells; emphasize computational and experimental integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combat Casualty Care — Optimize
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimize: Ensuring peak warfighter performance, both physical and cognitive, throughout all phases of a mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should target technologies or interventions that maximize physiological and cognitive readiness across mission phases, with measurable performance metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combat Casualty Care — Prevent
rubrics_metrics.description: Prevent: Protecting warfighters from any threat and advancing capabilities on the battlefield for immediate injury treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should focus on prevention strategies (biological or technological) and rapid-response treatments that reduce incidence or severity of battlefield injuries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combat Casualty Care — Restore
rubrics_metrics.description: Restore: Creating biotechnological approaches to provide tactical care and restore function to injured warfighters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efforts should develop restorative/tactical care technologies that can be applied in operational settings to return injured personnel to function or expedite recovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logistics — Do (operational resilience)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do: Creating solutions that increase operational resilience and logistic security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate how proposed technologies materially improve logistics robustness and security in contested or austere environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logistics — Make (point-of-need production)
rubrics_metrics.description: Make: Utilizing the advantages of biology to enable point-of-need production or strengthen existing supply chain for critical commodities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should enable distributed, point-of-need biomanufacturing or biologically enabled production to reduce dependence on vulnerable supply chains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logistics — Strengthen (harden operations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen: Providing technologies that harden operations against disruption and expand capabilities in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efforts should harden operational capability against disruption through biological technologies, materials (e.g., fibers for garments), or manufacturing approaches that extend field capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for high‑risk, high‑payoff R&D and program manager vision
rubrics_metrics.description: BTO program managers are visionary leaders whose experience spans industry, government, and academia. They conceive, plan, and oversee the high‑risk R&D efforts for which DARPA is known.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should be ambitious and accept technical risk if potential payoff is transformative; proposers should align with program manager-led vision and demonstrate a credible plan to explore high-risk hypotheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement types — R&D programs, challenges, and technology transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities include R&D programs and efforts, challenge competitions, and technology transition efforts for the Biological Technologies Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams can engage via formal DARPA programs (broad solicitations), challenge competitions, or transition-focused activities; proposals should target the appropriate engagement modality and articulate transition pathways to deployment or impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finite-duration programs with transformative, lasting impact
rubrics_metrics.description: BTO research programs are finite in duration, but the revolutionary advancements they drive create lasting change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should plan for a finite program term with milestones that demonstrate progress toward transformative outcomes and clear plans for sustaining or transitioning capability after program end.
